text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَبْشِرُوا۟ بِٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

words.gloss_range: emphatic opening particle governing a long nominal frame whose delayed predicate is angelic descent and reassurance
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) begins the ayah as a confirmed report and governs more than the quoted confession: its delayed predicate is the angelic descent. Its compact doubled opening sound gives the threshold audible pressure before the ayah expands through identity, steadfastness, descent, and promise, marking a new confirmed scene after the condemned speech of 41:29.

topics.headline: emphatic governance over delayed predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle governs more than the quoted confession; it frames the whole report of angelic descent as confirmed news.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the ayah as one emphatic inna-clause with a delayed predicate.

topics.headline: emphasis plus syntactic holding force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that emphasis and governance work together, so certainty is not detached from syntax.
topics.reason: The local clause requires both assertive force and syntactic government across the long subject-predicate frame.

topics.headline: compressed opening sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact doubled sound at the opening before the ayah expands into a long predicate.
topics.reason: The sound row supports the opening pressure without changing the grammar.

topics.headline: boundary into confirmed reassurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah as a new confirmed scene after the condemned speech of 41:29.
topics.reason: The boundary row coheres with the emphatic opening and does not override local syntax.

topics.headline: four-beat reassurance architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an ordered movement from identity to steadfastness to angelic descent to promise.
topics.reason: The delayed predicate and sequence rows describe the ayah-level architecture licensed by the full clause.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative head defining a behavior-based cohort through confession and steadiness
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) turns the recipients into a behavior-defined cohort rather than a named lineage or status group. Its plural relative shape makes confession and steadfastness a repeatable eligibility pattern, and the predicate waits until both actions have built the group. Across the boundary from 41:29, the same classifier style now identifies the upright rather than the condemned.

topics.headline: relative head defines the cohort
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is grammatically built by the following actions, not simply named.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment parse the word as the governed relative head of the inna-subject.

topics.headline: actions become identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that confession and persistence become the group label itself.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun substantivizes the action clauses into a cohort description.

topics.headline: plural class eligibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise is framed for a repeatable group, not one isolated person.
topics.reason: The masculine plural relative shape supports collective eligibility.

topics.headline: boundary contrastive classifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the relative label turning from condemned classification in 41:29 to upright classification in 41:30.
topics.reason: The boundary contrast is coherent with the local relative-pronoun function.

topics.headline: predicate postponed until double qualification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the outcome waits until both defining actions are complete.
topics.reason: The relative clause architecture delays the predicate until the cohort has been fully specified.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural speech verb presenting confession as an achieved collective declaration of allegiance
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on saying, speech, utterance, claim, and verbal commitment; the local quote selects declarative allegiance rather than mere narration
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) is not empty speech: the quote that follows makes it a collective confession of allegiance. Its perfect plural Form I presents the declaration as their own achieved, direct utterance, while the sequence with the next verb keeps that speech from being sufficient by itself. Against formula without integrity (63:1), the ayah makes truthful human speech receive answering angelic speech.

topics.headline: quoted confession governed by speech verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb carries a specific quoted content, not bare utterance.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the following nominal clause as the quoted complement.

topics.headline: qawl as allegiance rather than report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices speech functioning as commitment because the quote names lordship.
topics.reason: The local quote narrows the speech root toward confession and allegiance.

topics.headline: perfect collective direct speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices achieved collective ownership of the confession through perfect aspect and plural marking.
topics.reason: The Form I perfect and plural suffix keep the speech direct and owned by the cohort.

topics.headline: true speech answered by angelic speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices human confession answered by descending angelic reassurance, with 63:1 as a contrast for formula without integrity.
topics.reason: The intertext and echo rows preserve the speech-contest backdrop while local grammar selects truthful confession.

topics.headline: first qualification before steadiness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that speech is necessary but structurally incomplete until steadfastness follows.
topics.reason: The verb stands before the connector and second qualifying verb inside the relative clause.

words.gloss_range: possessive lordship title functioning as subject of a verbless confession and binding the speakers to divine governance
words.root_gloss_range: root range of lordship, ownership, nurturing, regulation, sustaining, and bringing to completion; locally it is relational lordship confessed by the cohort
words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbunā}}) makes lordship relational before the proper name identifies the referent. The possessive suffix carries the confessing group inside the title, so dependence, nurture, mastery, and governance are voiced as an owned allegiance that must continue in steadfastness. The same lordship language moves from desperate plea in 41:29 to settled confession here, and that confessed relation anchors the promise at the close.

topics.headline: possessive subject of nominal confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that lordship is stated as a standing identity relation inside a verbless quote.
topics.reason: The word is the possessive nominative subject with the proper name as predicate.

topics.headline: lordship as nurture and mastery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepting a Lord entails ongoing alignment under sustaining governance.
topics.reason: The root pressure coheres with the later steadfastness clause without replacing the local title sense.

topics.headline: suffix fuses cohort to title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the confessing group carried inside the title itself.
topics.reason: The first-person plural suffix and construct shape make the relation internal to the word.

topics.headline: confessed Lord grounds promise and reverses 41:29
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same lordship language moving from desperate plea in 41:29 to settled confession in 41:30.
topics.reason: Boundary and echo rows support the contrast while local grammar keeps the word as the quote subject.

topics.headline: relation before named referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that dependence is voiced before the name that fills the role.
topics.reason: The order of the quoted nominal clause places the relational title first.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name completing the quoted identity equation as the sole referent of confessed lordship
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field related to worship-reference and deity designation; locally the proper name fixes the referent, not a generic category
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) completes the quote as the named predicate: their Lord is {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}). The proper name keeps the confession from remaining an abstract deity claim and compresses exclusivity without spelling it out as in 20:14. Its dense doubled sound matches its syntactic weight, and the named divine referent anchors the passive promise that closes the ayah.

topics.headline: proper-name predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quote is an identity equation completed by a named predicate.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the proper noun as the predicate of the quoted nominal clause.

topics.headline: proper name over generic deity category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the confession identifies the worship-referent rather than invoking an abstract deity concept.
topics.reason: The proper-name evidence and derivational dispute enrich the field without changing the referent.

topics.headline: nominative proper noun density
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the form resisting an indefinite or generic reading.
topics.reason: The nominative proper noun functions as a definite predicate in the quote.

topics.headline: named source of implicit promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the named Allah at the opening grounds the later passive promise even when the promiser is not restated.
topics.reason: The surah and closure echoes connect the opening name to the final promise frame.

topics.headline: verbless theology as standing identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices lordship as a standing relation, not a timed event.
topics.reason: The verbless clause architecture supports the identity reading.

words.gloss_range: delayed-sequence conjunction marking interval and rank between confession and uprightness
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) is the visible hinge that keeps confession and uprightness from collapsing into one moment. It is delayed sequence and rank, not simple addition: speech comes first, then sustained straightness becomes the later proving stage before angelic descent. After the accusation register of 41:29, this connector installs disciplined moral order.

topics.headline: delayed sequence, not simple addition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that steadfastness is a later proving stage after confession.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the two relative-clause verbs with tarakhi rather than plain coordination.

topics.headline: interval and rank together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices semantic space between verbal allegiance and harder-won continued alignment.
topics.reason: The particle carries ordered delay and rank in this local sequence.

topics.headline: visible standalone hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a surface pause between the two qualifying verbs.
topics.reason: The independent particle marks the boundary visibly.

topics.headline: ordered qualification after 41:29
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices disciplined moral sequence after the chaotic accusation register of 41:29.
topics.reason: The boundary row coheres with the connector function.

topics.headline: declaration separated from verification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the spoken claim must be verified over time.
topics.reason: The connector prevents the two verbs from being read as one undifferentiated action.

words.gloss_range: Form X perfect plural verb of maintained uprightness, broad in scope because no object is named
words.root_gloss_range: root range of standing, rising, establishing, maintaining, straightening, and rectitude; locally Form X selects sustained straight-course alignment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟}} ({{tr:istaqāmū}}) names an achieved state of maintained straightness, not a single listed deed. Its objectless Form X makes the whole course of life the test, turning spoken confession into legible continuity before the angels descend. The straight-course image answers misguidance at the boundary and shows the command to be straight in 41:6 and 11:112 as embodied fulfillment here.

topics.headline: objectless perfect qualification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices uprightness as a completed qualifying state with broad scope, not one named act.
topics.reason: The perfect Form X verb takes no object and qualifies the relative cohort.

topics.headline: straightness counters misguidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices moral continuity pictured as standing straight after a boundary scene of misguidance.
topics.reason: The q-w-m field supports standing and maintained rectitude as local image-pressure.

topics.headline: Form X maintained straightness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the form selecting entry into and maintenance of a straight course rather than bare standing.
topics.reason: Form X evidence distinguishes this from a simple standing verb.

topics.headline: commanded straightness fulfilled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an earlier command to be straight, especially 41:6 and 11:112, appearing here as embodied response.
topics.reason: The intertext rows name command-to-fulfillment echoes without controlling the local parse.

topics.headline: hinge before descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sustained uprightness positioned between human confession and heavenly response.
topics.reason: The verb follows the sequence particle and precedes the descent predicate.

words.gloss_range: Form V imperfect descent verb presenting successive angelic arrival as the predicate response to completed human stance
words.root_gloss_range: root range of descending, sending down, lodging, arrival, and provision; locally it is angelic descent that arrives with reassurance
words.prose: {{ar:تَتَنَزَّلُ}} ({{tr:tatanazzalu}}) shifts the ayah from completed human acts to an ongoing heavenly response. Its Form V and doubled center make descent feel successive and layered, while the delayed subject lets arrival strike before the angels are named. The word reverses the unbelieving angel-demand of 41:14 and redirects the angelic descent formula of 97:4 into reassuring, enveloping arrival over the steadfast.

topics.headline: imperfect response with delayed subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from completed human stance to present, ongoing angelic arrival.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb precedes its delayed nonhuman plural subject and agrees with it normally.

topics.headline: descent as delegated delivery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reassurance arriving from above and settling over the recipients.
topics.reason: The n-z-l field supports descent, delivery, and arrival while context anchors authority in Allah.

topics.headline: Form V successive descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices repeated or unfolding descent rather than a single dispatch.
topics.reason: Derived-form and sound rows support successive descent without importing another construction.

topics.headline: angel-demand reversed into granted descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices earlier angel-descent demand in 41:14 and the 97:4 descent formula redirected into reassurance for the upright.
topics.reason: The concrete echoes are preserved as contrast and formula, not as control over the local syntax.

topics.headline: arrival foregrounded before agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the descent event before the agents are disclosed.
topics.reason: Verb-before-subject order foregrounds motion and recipient coverage.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus third-person plural pronoun marking the defined cohort as the surface or field of angelic descent
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمُ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhimu}}) routes the descent back onto the same cohort already defined by confession and steadfastness. With a descent verb, the preposition gives the arrival an over-them, covering force before the angels are named. The fused preposition-and-pronoun form compresses relation and recipient into one marker, keeping the covered group audible before the delayed agents appear.

topics.headline: pronoun resumes the cohort
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the angelic descent targets the same group defined at the start.
topics.reason: The suffix resumes the relative head and is governed by the descent verb.

topics.headline: upon-coverage force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reassurance falling upon and over the recipients, not merely moving toward them.
topics.reason: The preposition with a descent verb supports coverage or enveloping force.

topics.headline: fused recipient marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices relation and recipient compressed into one attached form.
topics.reason: The preposition and pronoun suffix are fused in the surface word.

topics.headline: recipients before agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices who is covered before hearing who descends.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase intervenes before the delayed subject.

words.gloss_range: definite plural angelic subject, delayed after the descent verb and recipient phrase, acting as unified delegated agency
words.root_gloss_range: root range linking angels, messengers, ownership, dominion, and kingship; locally the angelic-envoy sense carries delegated authority
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ}} ({{tr:al-malāʾikatu}}) finally names the agents after the action and recipients have already been foregrounded. The definite plural functions as one coordinated heavenly agency: many angels, unified by Arabic agreement, carrying delegated authority rather than originating the promise. The angel-demand environment of 41:14 and the descent formula of 97:4 are narrowed here to personal reassurance over those who stood firm.

topics.headline: delayed definite plural subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that many angels function as one coordinated subject after the descent verb.
topics.reason: Arabic agreement normalizes a nonhuman plural subject with feminine singular verbal agreement.

topics.headline: delegated messenger agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the angels deliver the message without becoming the source of the promise.
topics.reason: The local clause assigns descent and speech to angels while the opening confession anchors authority in Allah.

topics.headline: broken plural as unified agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices plurality without dispersed agency.
topics.reason: The plural noun works with singular agreement as one heavenly class.

topics.headline: angel descent formula narrowed to reassurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices angelic descent from 41:14 and 97:4 narrowed to personal reassurance over the steadfast.
topics.reason: The echoes remain formulaic and contextual while the local subject is the definite angelic class.

topics.headline: agent disclosed after arrival and recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the unseen agents only after descent and coverage have been dramatized.
topics.reason: Subject postponement makes arrival and recipient field precede agent naming.

words.gloss_range: contracted content/purpose particle introducing the angelic announcement and pivoting narration into address
words.prose: {{ar:أَلَّا}} ({{tr:allā}}) is the compressed hinge from narrated descent to the angels' message. It embeds the reassurance as what the angels bring and also lets their descent function as reassurance itself. At this point the discourse turns from third-person report into direct address, reversing the speech register of 41:29 through two removals, fear and grief, followed by one bestowed glad tiding.

topics.headline: content particle for angelic message
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the commands are attached to what the angels bring, not isolated sayings.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following clause as content or purpose of the descent event.

topics.headline: content and purpose pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the angels both say reassurance and descend in order to reassure.
topics.reason: Both content and purpose readings are locally useful after the descent verb.

topics.headline: contracted quote entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a compressed pivot into negative reassurance.
topics.reason: The contracted surface form joins the complementizer and negator.

topics.headline: speech register reversed from 41:29
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices condemned speech giving way to direct angelic consolation in 41:30.
topics.reason: The boundary row coheres with the local discourse shift.

topics.headline: narration turns to direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices third-person report becoming second-person reassurance.
topics.reason: The verbs after the particle address the recipients directly.

words.gloss_range: objectless second-person plural fear prohibition cancelling the future-facing threat horizon
words.root_gloss_range: root range of fear, dread, apprehension, and anticipated harm; locally it is future-directed anxiety removed by angelic speech
words.prose: {{ar:تَخَافُوا۟}} ({{tr:takhāfū}}) begins the angelic reassurance by cancelling fear without naming a single object. That objectless second-person plural form expands relief across the future horizon and makes the described cohort hear the command directly. The familiar no-fear/no-grief formula, as in 2:38, is recast here as present angelic speech before grief is removed and promise is given.

topics.headline: objectless second-person prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices fear removed broadly and personally, not as a detached description.
topics.reason: The verb is governed by the negative announcement frame and leaves the feared object unexpressed.

topics.headline: future-directed fear cancelled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the forward-looking emotional state removed before sorrow over loss is addressed.
topics.reason: The kh-w-f field points to anticipated harm and pairs with grief.

topics.headline: plural address sustained
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the described cohort now hearing the command directly.
topics.reason: The plural ending carries the same group into angelic address.

topics.headline: no-fear formula made direct speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the familiar no-fear/no-grief reassurance formula, including 2:38, recast as direct angelic speech.
topics.reason: The formulaic echo supports the local second-person command.

topics.headline: first negation clears the future
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices future dread cleared before positive glad tidings can land.
topics.reason: The command is first in the two-negation-plus-glad-tidings sequence.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction linking the second negative reassurance clause to the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before the second negation coordinates a whole second reassurance clause, not just another word. After the first negation it works as an additive nor-link, pairing fear-removal with grief-removal. Because the conjunction is split before the repeated negator, coordination and fresh negation remain visibly distinct, so grief is not an afterthought.

topics.headline: coordination of second negative clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices grief removal coordinated as a full clause alongside fear removal.
topics.reason: The split conjunction coordinates the following negated verb clause.

topics.headline: nor-link after first negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices additive negation pairing two emotional cancellations.
topics.reason: After the first negative clause, the conjunction creates the sense of a second nor-like denial.

topics.headline: split conjunction before repeated negator
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices coordination and negation displayed as separate functions.
topics.reason: The bundle split reflects the visible conjunction before the independent negative particle.

topics.headline: paired negative parallelism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that grief is not an afterthought but the second arm of the reassurance pair.
topics.reason: The conjunction builds parallelism before the positive turn.

words.gloss_range: second negative particle scoping specifically over the grief verb and resetting the reassurance frame
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) gives grief its own negation instead of letting it borrow the first one. Its scope stops at the following grief verb and does not swallow the glad-tidings command, so the speech can turn afterward from removal of distress to positive promise. As a standalone reset, it makes the second negative command rhythmically and grammatically separate.

topics.headline: second negator with limited scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negation belongs to grief specifically and does not swallow the glad-tidings command.
topics.reason: Attachment and local syntax scope this particle over the following verb only.

topics.headline: grief independently cancelled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sorrow named and removed in its own right.
topics.reason: The repeated negator blocks grief separately from fear.

topics.headline: visible syntactic restart
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second negative command restarting rhythmically and grammatically.
topics.reason: The standalone negator resets the clause before the grief verb.

topics.headline: two balanced removals before joy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices fear and grief each receiving grammatical removal before the positive command arrives.
topics.reason: The repeated negator creates two balanced clauses rather than one broad denial.

words.gloss_range: objectless second-person plural grief prohibition cancelling backward-looking sorrow and rough emotional burden
words.root_gloss_range: root range of grief, sadness, sorrow, and rugged roughness; locally it names past- or loss-facing sorrow removed by angelic reassurance
words.prose: {{ar:تَحْزَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:taḥzanū}}) completes the emotional pair by removing grief without limiting it to one loss. After future fear is cancelled, this second-person plural verb clears backward-looking sorrow, with the rough-ground field of the root making grief feel like a burdened terrain released by angelic speech. The restored-loss echo of 28:13 is widened here into direct reassurance for the steadfast.

topics.headline: direct plural grief prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same cohort addressed personally with a separate command-level negation.
topics.reason: The verb is governed by the second negative particle and carries second-person plural address.

topics.headline: grief as backward sorrow and rough burden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sorrow treated as the past-facing counterpart to fear, with roughness pressure in the root field.
topics.reason: The h-z-n field supports grief and rugged emotional weight without changing the local prohibition.

topics.headline: plural ending keeps address continuous
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same recipients carried from fear removal into grief removal.
topics.reason: The plural ending repeats the address form of the previous prohibition.

topics.headline: no-grief formula intensified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices no-grief reassurance, including 28:13 as a restored-loss echo, universalized for the steadfast.
topics.reason: The concrete echo and formula rows preserve the grief-removal field.

topics.headline: second emotion completes the span
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the full emotional timeline closed before glad tidings begin.
topics.reason: The verb completes the pair with the preceding fear verb.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction pivoting from two negative reassurances to the positive glad-tidings imperative
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the tight turn that keeps the angelic message from ending with absence of distress. As a proclitic hinge before the positive imperative, it joins the command to receive glad tidings to the two removals, making one speech sequence move from fearlessness and grieflessness into promised joy. Across the boundary, punitive commands in 41:29 are answered by a comforting command in 41:30.

topics.headline: coordination of positive imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the glad-tidings command as part of the same angelic utterance.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the positive imperative with the preceding negative clauses.

topics.headline: additive pivot into joy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an emotional replacement, not merely another item in a list.
topics.reason: The following imperative changes the speech-act type from prohibition to reception of good news.

topics.headline: tight proclitic hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the turn to positive command as immediate rather than a new detached sentence.
topics.reason: The written conjunction fuses to the following imperative in the recited phrase.

topics.headline: command register transformed from 41:29
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices punitive commands in 41:29 answered by a comforting command in 41:30.
topics.reason: The boundary row coheres with the local positive-command pivot.

topics.headline: negation becomes positive reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sequence compelled toward a named promise after two emotional removals.
topics.reason: The conjunction links three speech acts into one ordered message.

words.gloss_range: Form IV plural imperative commanding reception of glad tidings anchored by the Garden, not self-generated optimism
words.root_gloss_range: root range linking skin, surface, human contact, good news, and glad tidings; locally it is commanded reception of joyous announcement
words.prose: {{ar:أَبْشِرُوا۟}} ({{tr:abshirū}}) turns cleared emotional space into a positive command: receive glad tidings. Its Form IV plural imperative makes joy responsive to an announcement rather than self-produced optimism, and the skin/surface field of the root lets the news reach felt human affect. The good-news-to-garden formula of 2:25 is dramatized here as angelic direct speech, replacing two negated states with one promise-bearing command.

topics.headline: imperative with specified content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices joy commanded as reception of a concrete promised object.
topics.reason: The imperative governs a following bi-phrase that supplies the content and cause of rejoicing.

topics.headline: glad news reaches the affective surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the announcement reversing fear and grief at the level of felt reception.
topics.reason: The b-sh-r field links surface, contact, and glad tidings while local grammar selects good-news reception.

topics.headline: Form IV plural imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the addressees entering a state of receiving glad news, not merely hearing a report.
topics.reason: Form IV imperative evidence supports reception of glad tidings and plural direct address.

topics.headline: good-news garden formula dramatized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the familiar good-news-to-garden formula, including 2:25, made immediate as angelic speech.
topics.reason: The formulaic echo is local because the Garden complement follows directly.

topics.headline: third speech act completes reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two removals replaced by one positive promise-bearing command.
topics.reason: The imperative follows the two negative commands as the sequence climax.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the Garden as the content and cause of the glad-tidings command
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is small but decisive: it fastens the glad-tidings command to its promised content and cause. The joy is therefore not free-floating mood; it is grammatically grounded in the Garden that follows. Its proclitic attachment, and the recited liaison into the definite noun, make the bridge from imperative to reward both visible and audible.

topics.headline: prepositional complement to glad tidings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Garden bound as the content and cause of rejoicing.
topics.reason: The preposition attaches the following genitive noun to the imperative.

topics.headline: joy textually grounded

topics.reason: The preposition functions as content/cause marker rather than spatial phrase.

topics.headline: proclitic attachment to reward noun

topics.headline: bridge from imperative to reward

topics.reason: The preposition bridges the imperative to the reward noun.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive Garden as the recognized promised object of glad tidings and protected enclosure answering fear and grief
words.root_gloss_range: root range of covering, concealment, hiddenness, enclosure, garden, and sheltered protection; locally the reward is the protected Garden, not hidden misguidance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجَنَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-jannati}}) names the content of the glad tidings as the recognized Garden, genitive after the preposition and immediately qualified by the promise clause. The {{ar:ج ن ن}} ({{tr:j-n-n}}) covering field lets the reward answer exposed fear and grief as protected enclosure, while 41:29 reverses hidden ruin into refuge. Its definite singular and geminated center concentrate the promise, and the good-news garden motif of 2:25 is compressed into this angelic command.

topics.headline: genitive definite promised object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Garden as the grammatically governed content of glad tidings, not a floating reward label.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the preposition and definite before the relative clause.

topics.headline: protected enclosure answers exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Garden as sheltered life-space answering fear and grief.
topics.reason: The j-n-n root pressure supports covering and enclosure while local grammar selects the Garden.

topics.headline: definite singular concentrated reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the promise concentrated in the recognized Garden.
topics.reason: Definiteness, singular form, and gemination support a compact recognized reward.

topics.headline: concealment reversed from hidden ruin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 41:29 hidden misguidance reversed into covered refuge in 41:30, with 2:25 as a good-news garden motif.
topics.reason: Boundary and motif rows preserve concrete echoes without changing the local noun sense.

topics.headline: reward receives closing promise tail
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reward noun becoming the anchor for the ayah closure.
topics.reason: The following relative clause ties the Garden to prior promise.

words.gloss_range: feminine singular relative pronoun locking the final promise clause onto the Garden
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّتِى}} ({{tr:allatī}}) locks the final clause onto the Garden. Its feminine singular agreement is the visible morphology lock that blocks the promise clause from floating back to the angels, the recipients, or the whole reassurance. By introducing the final promise clause, it makes the reward recognizable and moves the ending toward promise rather than merely naming paradise.

topics.headline: feminine relative agreement with Garden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final clause qualifying the Garden specifically.
topics.reason: Agreement with the feminine singular antecedent makes the relative clause adjectival to the Garden.

topics.headline: Garden made recognizable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reward as known through promise rather than new information.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun specifies the definite antecedent.

topics.headline: visible morphology lock
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices morphology fastening the clause to its antecedent.
topics.reason: The feminine singular form mirrors the Garden noun.

topics.headline: relative clause turns reward into promised closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ending landing on promise rather than merely naming paradise.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun introduces the final promise clause.

words.gloss_range: defective perfect auxiliary with second-person plural suffix, giving the passive promise a prior-continuing state frame
words.root_gloss_range: root range of being, becoming, occurrence, existence, and state; locally it functions as an auxiliary marking enduring promised status
words.prose: {{ar:كُنتُمْ}} ({{tr:kuntum}}) makes the promise a prior, continuing state for the same addressees. The auxiliary does not assert independent existence here; it holds the promise over time, while the second-person suffix carries the direct-address cohort into the final clause. Human maintained uprightness is answered by maintained promise, with 35:5 supporting the promise-truth horizon now surrounding them.

topics.headline: auxiliary with passive promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise had been in force before this announcement.
topics.reason: The defective perfect functions with the following passive verb as an auxiliary frame.

topics.headline: being as held promised state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the promise as a status surrounding the addressees, not a spontaneous final announcement.
topics.reason: The k-w-n field contributes state-holding while local grammar keeps auxiliary function.

topics.headline: second-person suffix sustains address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same people addressed through the final clause.
topics.reason: The 2mp suffix matches the earlier plural commands.

topics.headline: steadfastness paired with maintained promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices human continuity answered by divine-side commitment, with 35:5 supporting promise as truth.
topics.reason: The echo rows pair sustained uprightness with sustained promise without changing syntax.

topics.headline: temporal bridge into closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices present glad tidings linked to past promise.
topics.reason: The auxiliary sits inside the final relative clause and bridges time at the ayah ending.

words.gloss_range: passive imperfect promise verb closing the ayah on recipient-centered, positive promised fulfillment supplied by the Garden antecedent
words.root_gloss_range: root range of promise, pledge, appointment, threat, and future commitment; locally the Garden and fear-cancellation select positive promise, not threat
words.prose: {{ar:تُوعَدُونَ}} ({{tr:tūʿadūn}}) closes the ayah on remembered promise. The passive imperfect foregrounds the recipients and is semantically complete because the promised Garden has already been supplied by the relative antecedent; the positive promise branch is fixed by the Garden and the removal of fear and grief. The ending joins the promise-truth field of 35:5 to the ayah's speech frame: human confession near the opening is answered by promised fulfillment at the final word.

topics.headline: passive with antecedent-supplied object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the passive as semantically complete because the Garden has already supplied what is promised.
topics.reason: The relative antecedent carries the object and the passive leaves the promiser contextually supplied.

topics.headline: positive promise, not threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root narrowed to assurance rather than warning.
topics.reason: The Garden and cancelled fear-grief frame select waad rather than threat.

topics.headline: recipient-centered passive imperfect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the addressees kept at the grammatical center of the promised future.
topics.reason: The passive imperfect and plural ending foreground the recipients.

topics.headline: promise-truth and speech-frame echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices broader promise-fulfillment register, including 35:5, and the opening human speech answered by promised speech at closure.
topics.reason: The formula and echo rows connect the local ending to wider eschatological promise without displacing local grammar.

topics.headline: final word lands on familiar promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the last weight falling not on fear, grief, or even the Garden alone, but on known commitment.
topics.reason: The final relative tail makes the whole angelic speech confirmation of prior promise.

baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken creed names the sole sovereign and then becomes an upright, sustained organizing line for conduct.

activation_trace.role: The belief-or-doctrine branch makes the utterance a publicly stated governing commitment rather than bare sound.
Lordship and sovereignty supply the commitment's governing authority.
The worshiped-one branch fixes the declaration's object as exclusive devotion.
Upright balance supplies the lived continuation introduced by thumma.

changed_reading.before: A profession of faith is followed by generic moral perseverance.
changed_reading.after: The profession installs one governing allegiance, and istiqama is the continuing bodily and practical alignment that makes the saying true.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تتنزل عليهم الملائكة ألا تخافوا ولا تحزنوا وأبشروا
baseline_models.mechanism: A descending angelic presence meets expected harm and grief's inner roughness with an announcement that visibly opens joy.

activation_trace.role: Descent and settling make the angelic event an arriving presence upon the steadfast.
The angel branch identifies the descending agents while retaining the root's forceful, coherent agency.
Fear as expectation of harm marks the threatened forward horizon that the message clears.
Grief as psychic roughness marks the burdened inner terrain that the message smooths.
Good news that opens the skin with joy makes reassurance somatically manifest rather than merely informational.

changed_reading.before: Angels deliver consoling information about a future reward.
changed_reading.after: Their descent is a present encounter that reorders the believer's threatened horizon and grief-marked interior, with joy beginning to show on the surface.

baseline_models.mechanism: Hospitality for one who descends, an enclosed and shielding garden, and a promise fixed to a meeting point combine into prepared protected reception.

activation_trace.role: Prepared hospitality for a descending guest turns descent toward reception rather than mere motion.
The tree-enclosed garden gives the promised destination a sheltered, cultivated material form.
The protective shield branch adds active refuge to the garden's enclosure.
A promise bounded by time or place makes the refuge an appointed reception rather than a vague hope.

changed_reading.before: The Garden is an abstract deferred reward promised in speech.
changed_reading.after: The Garden is an appointed, already oriented place of welcome and protection toward which the angelic arrival begins the transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier command directs istiqama toward God and immediately pairs it with forgiveness, so steadfastness becomes maintained orientation with repair built into it, not flawless immobility.

activation_trace.role: Uprightness and balance anchor the focus state that context specifies.
The same uprightness branch is explicitly commanded toward Him, supplying direction to the focus form.
Covering sin while protecting its bearer supplies a restorative operation adjacent to the command.

structural_cues: 41:6 uses fa-staqimu ilayhi and immediately follows it with wa-staghfiruhu.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direction plus adjacent forgiveness; I infer that repair belongs inside steadfastness rather than proving its failure, while the live alternative is that forgiveness addresses a separate class of sins.

changed_reading.before: They attained and preserved an unbroken state of rectitude.
changed_reading.after: They kept reorienting toward their Lord along an upright line whose continuity includes seeking repair after deviation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The heavens and earth answer a divine address by saying they come willingly; this makes the focus sequence of saying and standing read as the human-scale form of a wider creaturely answer-through-alignment.

activation_trace.role: Declared belief anchors the human answer whose practical truth is at issue.
Upright alignment supplies the enacted continuation of the human answer.
Uttered speech supplies the cosmos's audible response to address.
Willing obedience makes that cosmic saying operative as compliant movement.

structural_cues: 41:11 coordinates divine address, the paired reply atayna, and the predicate ta'i'in.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel saying and willing alignment; I infer a human-cosmic analogy, while the alternative is that the verbal recurrence is only narrative and does not define istiqama.

changed_reading.before: Our Lord is Allah is a private human confession later supported by conduct.
changed_reading.after: The confession is a creaturely answer to address, and istiqama is the specifically human way of coming willingly into the order already answered by heaven and earth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Revelation is delivered downward from mercy at the opening, angels descend in the focus, and prepared hospitality follows immediately from forgiveness and mercy; the focus descent occupies the middle of one hospitable corridor.

activation_trace.role: Delivery downward makes revelation the first movement in the surah's descent sequence.
Merciful tenderness names the source-quality of the opening descent.
Angelic descent and settling form the corridor's personal middle movement.
Prepared hospitality converts the repeated root into reception for the arriving guests.
Protective covering of fault grounds the hospitality in forgiveness rather than earned entitlement.
Merciful tenderness closes the descent sequence with the same source-quality that opened it.

structural_cues: The surah opens with tanzil in 41:2 and resumes immediately after the focus with nuzulan in 41:32, bracketing tatanazzalu.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered n-z-l recurrence and matching mercy language; I infer one coordinated movement from message to messengers to reception, while the alternative keeps revelation, angelic visitation, and hospitality as independent uses.

changed_reading.before: The angelic descent is an isolated miraculous announcement inside the ayah.
changed_reading.after: It is the personal middle phase of a surah-long descent: mercy sends guidance down, accompanies those aligned with it, and receives them as protected guests.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rejecters demand that angels be sent down as externally compelling proof, but angels actually descend upon those who commit and stand; the same image reverses from demanded spectacle to intimate assurance.

activation_trace.role: Requested delivery downward supplies the rejected party's proposed test of the messengers.
Angels are the demanded visible agents in that counterfactual test.
Covering the truth marks the posture from which the demand is issued.
Actual descent and settling answer the earlier demand in a different relational setting.
The same class of agents now addresses steadfast recipients rather than coercing rejecters.

structural_cues: 41:14 places la-anzala mala'ikatan inside a rejecting objection; 41:30 states tatanazzalu alayhimu al-mala'ikatu as realized action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unrealized demand and a later realized descent; I infer a reversal from public proof to relational accompaniment, while the live alternative is that the two descents refer to unrelated occasions or thresholds.

changed_reading.before: Angels descend because steadfast believers qualify for a supernatural reward.
changed_reading.after: The descent also answers the surah's earlier angel-demand by relocating disclosure: angels are not furnished to bypass trust, but become companions of a trust already embodied.

context_deltas.mechanism: Assigned companions bind themselves to people and beautify what lies before and behind them; immediately after the focus, the descending speakers identify themselves as near, managing allies across worldly and later life, replacing distortion with protective accompaniment.

activation_trace.role: A companion joined to another supplies the corrupt accompaniment operating before the focus.
Making something appear beautiful supplies that accompaniment's perceptual distortion.
The descending angels anchor the identity of the new speakers and companions.
Taking charge of an affair makes their nearness an active, protective accompaniment.
Love, support, and alliance supply the benevolent quality opposite the earlier companions' distortion.

structural_cues: 41:25 spans ma bayna aydihim wa-ma khalfahum, while 41:31 spans al-hayati al-dunya wa-fi al-akhirah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed forms of companionship and two extended spans; I infer an exchange or exposure of allegiances, while the alternative is that the angels announce guardianship that was always present rather than replacing anything.

changed_reading.before: The angels arrive briefly to deliver reassurance.
changed_reading.after: Their descent discloses a durable counter-companionship: steadfastness changes who mediates one's field of perception and who remains near across both lives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passage after the focus tests excellent speech by invitation, right action, peaceful identity, pushing away evil with what is better, and patient restraint; istiqama becomes relational work that converts hostility rather than private stasis.

activation_trace.role: A declared belief anchors the speech that the following passage tests in action.
Resolve and rising to an undertaking make istiqama active rather than inert.
Sincere care for something makes good speech a committed concern, not rhetorical display.
Calling and inclining another by speech turns the declaration outward as invitation.
Doing the beautiful supplies the positive material used against an evil relation.
Removing a harmful thing supplies the forceful but non-retaliatory operation on hostility.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the discipline that keeps the better response available.

structural_cues: 41:33 couples best speech with calling, doing right, and saying I am of those who submit; 41:34-35 then gives a conflict operation and its patience condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate sequence from speech to practice and transformed enmity; I infer that it unfolds the focus's istiqama, while the alternative treats it as a new exhortation with no retrospective definition of 41:30.

changed_reading.before: Steadfastness is mainly preserving one's own confession under pressure.
changed_reading.after: It is the repeatable craft of making confession socially true: inviting, acting well, absorbing provocation without mirroring it, and opening the possibility that an enemy becomes a close ally.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing human portrait swings from tireless demand for good to severed hope under a touch of harm, then from blessing to withdrawal; against this foil, istiqama is a non-transactional relation that survives changing states, and no fear or grief removes the swing's affective motors.

activation_trace.role: Upright balance anchors the stable posture sharpened by the later oscillations.
Expected harm names one forward-driving force from which the stable posture is released.
Psychic roughness under grief names the complementary burden from which it is released.
A mere impact reaching the person supplies the small event that triggers the surrounding collapse.
Severed hope supplies the first extreme of the harm-triggered reaction.
A second severing of hope intensifies the collapse rather than balancing it.
Good condition and blessing supply the opposite circumstance that nonetheless triggers relational withdrawal.
Drawing one's side away supplies the bodily geometry of blessing-conditioned estrangement.

structural_cues: 41:49-51 repeatedly alternate good, mercy, harm, and blessing through conditional turns, while the person's claim, despair, prayer, and withdrawal change with the condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a late portrait of state-dependent reaction; I read it as a foil to istiqama because of the shared surah and sharp posture contrast, while the alternative is that it indicts ingratitude without defining the steadfast group.

changed_reading.before: Steadfastness means holding correct belief despite external opposition.
changed_reading.after: It also means refusing to make lordship contingent on felt fortune: neither harm severs hope nor blessing produces entitled withdrawal, so fear and grief no longer govern the relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same q-w-m inventory moves from uprightness now to the Day of Rising and the denied standing Hour; present istiqama becomes an anticipatory way of standing that corresponds to secure arrival then.

activation_trace.role: Present uprightness anchors the ethical posture from which the temporal bridge begins.
A heart settled in security supplies the contrasting mode of arrival on the Day.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour move the root's standing image to the final horizon.
The claim that the Hour is not standing supplies the explicit denial opposed to anticipatory uprightness.

structural_cues: 41:40 contrasts being cast into fire with coming secure on yawm al-qiyamah; 41:50 voices doubt that al-sa'ata qa'imah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated q-w-m forms with ethical and eschatological branches; I infer that uprightness rehearses future standing, while the alternative keeps istiqama and qiyamah as conventional senses without a functional bridge.

changed_reading.before: Istiqama secures a reward that will be received at resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Istiqama is already a mode of resurrection-facing standing: the believer embodies now the stability of the Day the reactive speaker denies, so the angelic assurance names secure continuity between the two standings.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses angelic and ecological descent and uses the packet's split r-b-b/r-b-w mapping. It remains anchored by the exact n-z-l recurrence, focus Rabb branch inventory, and first-sign branch of b-sh-r. Downstream prose should mark it as a rain-and-growth analogy, not an etymology of Rabb or a claim that angels are rain.

activation_trace.role: Nourishment and growth provide an exploratory developmental resonance inside the packet's split mapping for Rabb.
Delivery downward anchors the angelic movement that the later rain scene reimages.
First signs or shoots make glad tidings the visible beginning of a promised state.
Water delivered downward supplies the ecological analogue for the focus descent.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supply the response to descent.
Increase and rising supply the upward answer to what came down.
Earth's life through rain completes the revivifying material analogy.

changed_reading.before: Angels descend to communicate a settled promise to already steadfast people.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their descent behaves like life-giving rain: what comes down elicits an answering rise, and glad tidings are the first visible growth of the promised life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it builds a spatial montage across adjacent ayat rather than a direct gloss. It remains anchored to the focus's q-w-m uprightness and n-z-l downward motion, set immediately after feet and lowness in 41:29. Downstream prose should call it a compositional vertical contrast, not a lexical equivalence or certain intended symbolism.

activation_trace.role: The trampling foot supplies the preceding scene's instrument of forced vertical abasement.
Low place beneath height supplies the destination wished for the misleaders.
Bodily standing supplies the focus's immediate counter-posture to forced lowness.
Upright balance turns that counter-posture into moral-spatial integrity.
Descent from above reverses the prior wish to push others down: help comes down upon those who stand.

changed_reading.before: The ayah simply contrasts faithful people with the condemned speakers before them.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it reverses the preceding vertical economy: instead of securing oneself by putting others beneath one's feet, one stands upright and receives a descent from above.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps the repeated spatial front-and-rear construction onto fear's anticipated future and grief's retained past. It remains anchored in the focus affect words and in the packet's 41:25/41:42 flank repetition. Downstream prose should qualify future/past as a reader-supplied temporal analogy, since the packet also supports ordinary spatial and social readings.

activation_trace.role: Expectation of harm supplies the threatened forward temporal flank.
Psychic roughness from grief supplies the burdened rear temporal flank.
Making things appear beautiful supplies the companions' distortion across the flanking field.
The idiomatic between-the-hands branch supplies the front flank that distortion occupies.
What lies behind supplies the paired rear flank under distortion.
Departure from truth and stability identifies what cannot penetrate the protected field.
The repeated front-flank construction supplies one side of revelation's inaccessibility to falsehood.
The repeated rear-flank branch completes revelation's protected surround.

changed_reading.before: Do not fear and do not grieve removes two private negative emotions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the assurance guards both temporal flanks: anticipated harm ahead and grief retained behind no longer let distorting companions rewrite the believer's horizon, in analogy with revelation's protected front and rear.

strongest_changes: The ordered n-z-l chain turns angelic descent into the middle phase of revelation, accompaniment, and prepared hospitality.
The 41:14/41:30 reversal relocates angels from demanded public spectacle to intimate assurance for trust already embodied.
The 41:25/41:31 contrast changes the descent from a brief message into durable counter-companionship.
The 41:49-51 foil recasts istiqama as freedom from blessing-and-harm oscillation, while q-w-m recurrence lets present uprightness anticipate secure resurrection standing.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah order creates lexical and structural reversals around the focus: repeated sayings are tested by trajectory, descent changes from demanded sign to merciful reception, and companionship, verticality, practice, and affective time converge without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle when the angelic descent occurs or whether it names one threshold or repeated accompaniment.
The cosmic-answer and resurrection-standing links are coherent root-and-sequence activations but may exceed deliberate inter-ayah linkage.
The rain-growth reading depends partly on a split mapped root, and the vertical and temporal-flank readings are compositional analogies that require explicit exploratory qualification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Sustained uprightness is met by descent.** **ق و م B008** gives straightness and uprightness, while **ن ز ل B001/B002** gives descent and being sent down. The sequence moves from a declared center, through sustained alignment, to angelic descent. I infer a vertical correspondence: stable human orientation becomes the receiving line for a descending confirmation. This differs sharply from demanding angels as prior proof in 41:14.
2. **The message clears both temporal directions.** **خ و ف B001** supplies anticipation of future harm, **ح ز ن B001** rough sadness over loss, **ب ش ر B005/B007** brightening tidings and visible forerunners, and **و ع د B001/B006** promise and promising sign. Negated fear and grief clear future and past while tidings open the promised destination. I infer that reassurance repairs temporal orientation as well as emotion.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:31 extends the momentary descent into continuing nearness and support across both lives. 41:32 then activates **ن ز ل B005**, showing that descent culminates in prepared guest-provision.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Upright persistence is met by repeated descent.** Lexically, `ق و م B008` is straightness and uprightness, `ن ز ل B001` descent/alighting, and `ب ش ر B005` face-brightening tidings. Structurally, declaration is followed by sustained straightness, then the intensive/repeated `تتنزل`; this vertically reverses 41:29’s wish to force others below. I assign uprightness the role of maintaining orientation and descent the role of bringing reassurance into that maintained line. The reciprocal fit between the two motions is abductive. The ayah reads as a spatial relation in which steadfast human alignment is met by descending support.

2. **Reassurance stabilizes both anticipated and retained harm.** `خ و ف B001` is fearful anticipation of harm, `ح ز ن B001` grief in the self, and `و ع د B001` a promise opening expectation. The paired prohibitions are followed by good news of what had been promised. I assign fear the forward-looking destabilizing role, grief the retained-affect role, and promise the role of replacing both with a reliable horizon. The temporal distinction is inferred from their placement and accepted scopes. The message therefore reads as stabilization of the person across remembered and anticipated time.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:34–35 showed that uprightness persists into social provocation and must be received as a difficult competence. This made 41:30’s angelic reassurance support for an ongoing practice, not only comfort at a terminal moment.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir nesneyi hareket ettirerek onun oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan uygulanan hareketi ve nesnenin sarsılması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin gevşeklik veya kararsızlık nedeniyle bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit kalamama ile düzensiz sallanma durumunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sallanan veya oynayan nesnenin çıkardığı sesin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin genel bir ses değil, hareketten doğan işitsel belirti oluşunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol nesnenin yerinde duramamasını ve hareket sırasında çıkan sesi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol kalp, deniz, diş, ağaç ve gök gürültüsü gibi alanlardaki şiddetli sarsıntıyı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun sallanmasına veya sarsılmasına neden olmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Fiziksel sarsılma alanı yakındır; bu kol hareket ettirme, sabit kalamama ve hareket sesini kurarken komşu kol farklı varlıklardaki şiddetli sarsıntıyı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda ses, nesnenin kararsız hareketi ve sallanmasının sonucu olarak ortaya çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol çan, gök gürültüsü ve bulut gibi kaynaklardan gelen çınlama ve gürleme seslerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir nesnenin hareketi sırasında ortaya çıkan işitilebilir sesi içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolun çekirdeği fiziksel kararsızlık ve sallanmadır, ses ikincildir; komşu kolda ses ve çınlama daha bağımsız bir anlam alanı oluşturur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol nesnenin oynatılması, yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insanda korku veya öfke yüzünden ortaya çıkan titremeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da gözle görülen düzensiz bir sarsılma veya titreme görünümü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda nesne ve fiziksel kararsızlık kurucudur; komşu kolda insan bedeni ile korku veya öfke nedeni kurucudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel sallama, hareketten doğan ses ve aynı kökteki duygusal titreme karşılaştırmaları fiziksel hareket çekirdeğinin sınırını en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: القلقلة والتقلقل: صوت الحركة، وتحريك الشيء حتى يتحرك ويضطرب، وقلة الثبوت في المكان

root_profile.summary: Kök, azlık; bir şeyin tepesi veya başı; büyük bir kap; yük taşıma, yükselme ve yola koyulma; korku ya da öfkeden titreme; nesnenin oynayıp yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesi olmak üzere altı ayrı anlam kolunda düzenlenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi, yönetim ve düzenleme çekirdeğini destekler. Bununla birlikte yalın ve mutlak kullanım Tanrı'ya özgüdür; insanlar ve nesneler için anlam, sahip olunan ya da yönetilen şeyin belirtilmesine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanrı'ya özgü mutlak kullanım ile bir şeyin sahibi ya da yöneticisi olmayı bildiren tamlamalı kullanım ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim ile ev, hayvan veya başka bir şey üzerinden kurulan tamlamalar aynı kapsamda değildir; tanım bu kullanım koşulunu korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlık ya da şey üzerinde sahiplik, üstün yetke ve düzenleyici yönetim kurma niteliğidir. Mutlak kullanım Tanrı'yı gösterirken başka kullanımlar yönetilen veya sahip olunan şeyi açıkça belirtir.

facets.statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.
Mutlak adlandırma Tanrı'ya özgüdür; insan için kullanım belirtilmiş bir şeye bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar sahip, buyruğu geçen yönetici, düzenleyici ve Tanrı anlamlarını ortak bir üstün yetke ilişkisi çevresinde toplar; mutlak kullanımın sınırını ayrıca belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sahiplik ile düzenleyici yetkenin birlikte anlatıldığı genel kavramsal bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sahiplik, üstün yetke ve yönetim çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Adın hiçbir bağlı unsur olmadan mutlak kullanıldığı inanç bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Mutlak kullanımın yalnız Tanrı'yı göstermesi sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ev, hayvan veya başka bir varlık üzerinde sahiplik ve yönetim bildiren tamlamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirtilen şey üzerindeki sahiplik ve yönetim ilişkisini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı; sahip, buyruğu geçen yönetici veya düzenleyici
evin sahibi veya ev işlerini yöneten kadın

error_profile.preserves: Üstün konum ve buyruk yetkisi yönünü kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Sahiplik, düzenleme ve Tanrı'ya özgü mutlak kullanım ayrımını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Mutlak kullanımın yalnız Tanrı'ya ayrılması ve düzenleyici yönetim boyutu bu daldadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tapınılan nesne ve yükselme çağrışımı komşu dalın ek alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin sahibi, yöneticisi veya üstün konumdaki varlığı anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme sahiplik ve üstünlük alanındadır; odak dal kullanımın mutlak ya da tamlamalı oluşunu ve düzenleyici yönetimi sınırlar, komşu dal ise tapınma nesnesine ve yükselme çağrışımına da açılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; sahiplik ve üstün yetke bakımından en yakın sınır karşılaştırmasını veren dal seçildi, yalnız aynı genel alanı paylaşan adaylar yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرب بمعنى الله تعالى، ومالك الشيء، وسيده المطاع، وصاحبه، ورب الدار والدابة والملك
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس حرف رب، ولا الرُّبّ الطلاء، ولا الربابة الوعاء أو العهد
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرب: الله تبارك وتعالى؛ ورب كل شيء مالكه (jamhara); رب كل شئ: مالكه؛ وقد قالوه في الجاهلية للملك؛ رببت القوم: سستهم (sihah); يكون الرب: المالك؛ ويكون الرب: السيد المطاع؛ ويكون الرب: المصلح (tahdhib); الرب مصدر مستعار للفاعل؛ لا يقال الرب مطلقا إلا لله؛ رب الدار ورب الفرس (mufradat); فالرب المالك والخالق والصاحب؛ والله جل ثناؤه الرب (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyi gözeterek düzeltme, geliştirme ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış duruma getirme sürecini tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Çocuk yetiştirme, mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama bu sürecin farklı nesneleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız bakım göstermeyi değil, gözetilen şeyi zaman içinde düzeltip tamamlamayı gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylemin yalın gelişim çekirdeği ile çocuk, mülk ve yapılan iyilik gibi nesnelere bağlı kullanımları ayrıştırılarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi sürekli gözetim altında düzeltmek, geliştirmek ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış durumuna ulaştırmaktır.

facets.statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.
Çocuk yetiştirme, bir mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama başlıca uygulamalardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar düzeltme, sürekli bakım, yetiştirme ve tamamlama öğelerini tek bir aşamalı gelişim sürecinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bakımın gelişme, düzeltme ve tamamlanma sonucuna yöneldiği bütün genel bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Aşamalı gelişim, bakım, düzeltme ve tamamlanma öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir çocuğun veya canlı varlığın gelişimini üstlenme bağlamında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sürekli bakım yoluyla gelişip olgunlaştırma sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mülk, iş veya yapılan iyilik gibi bir nesneyi eksiksiz duruma getirme bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Düzeltme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucunu korur.
Gözetim ve ilgilenme yönünü kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Düzeltme, aşamalı geliştirme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucunu kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gözetilen şeyi aşama aşama geliştirme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucu odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aralıklı yoklama, öğüt verme ve çevresel bakım gibi tamamlanma gerektirmeyen kullanımlar komşuda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin bakımını üstlenme, onu düzeltme ve iyi durumda tutma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gelişim sürecini tamamlanma sınırına taşır; komşu dal ise bakımın yinelenmesini ve gözetimi sonuçtan bağımsız olarak kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bakım ile tamamlama arasındaki en ince sınırı gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız büyüme, akrabalık veya olgunluk alanını paylaşanlar dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست السيادة المجردة بلا معنى الإصلاح، ولا القرابة الربيبة نفسها
branches.source_phrase_ar: رب الرجل النعمة يربها ربا؛ ربابة أيضا إذا تممها (jamhara); رب الضيعة أي أصلحها وأتمها؛ رب فلان ولده؛ رباه (sihah); رب الشيء أي أصلحه؛ رب فلان الصنيعة إذا أتمها وأصلحها (tahdhib); التربية، وهو إنشاء الشيء حالا فحالا إلى حد التمام؛ ربه ورباه ورببه (mufradat); رب فلان ضيعته إذا قام على إصلاحها؛ رببت الصبي أربه (maqayis); ربته تربيتا إذا رببه (maqayis-rbt)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, Tanrı bilgisiyle donanmış, dinî hükümleri bilen, bilgeliği olan ve başkalarını temel bilgilerden başlayarak yetiştiren bilgin tipini ortak bir kimlikte birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal sıradan bilgi sahipliğini değil, Tanrı bilgisi, dinî uzmanlık ve öğretici yetiştirme görevini birlikte taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan bilgin ve öğretici kişi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka yapılardan anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı bilgisine ve dinî hükümlere hâkim, bilgece davranan ve insanları temel bilgiden ileri bilgiye doğru yetiştiren bilgindir.

facets.statement: Kişi Tanrı bilgisiyle ve dinî konulardaki sağlam bilgisiyle tanımlanır.
Bilgiyi yalnız taşımakla kalmaz, başkalarını küçük adımlarla öğretip yetiştirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar Tanrı'yı bilme, dinî hükümleri kavrama, bilgelik ve aşamalı öğreticilik özelliklerini aynı bilgin kişide bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dinî bilgi, bilgelik ve öğretici yetiştiricilik özelliklerinin birlikte vurgulandığı kişi için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tanrı bilgisi, bilginlik ve aşamalı öğreticilik öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin dinî uzmanlığı ile insan yetiştirme görevini birlikte anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dinî uzmanlık ve öğretici yetiştirme görevini birlikte korur.
